newsitem.title: USA: Sparks Companies opens Winnipeg office.
newsitem.headline: Sparks Companies opens Winnipeg office.

text.p: Leading U.S. agribusiness consultant Sparks Companies Inc said it had opened a business office in Winnipeg, Manitoba, to strengthen its commercial operations in Canada.
The office will be managed by former Winnipeg Commodity Exchange official John De Pape and former Canadian Wheat Board trader and analyst, Ron Gibson.

Memphis-based Sparks also has offices in Washington, D.C., Ottawa, Canada, and Buenos Aires, Argentina. Sparks also operates a joint venture with China's Ministry of Agriculture in Beijing, East-West Consultants Ltd.
